conditions: Disruption is not AABC: a clean round 1, a round 2 with 3+ conduits defended, and a round 3 with 2-3 defended all pay from B; from round 4 on, only a round where at least one conduit is lost pays B; a clean round pays C (Dante) instead.
Vessel Capillaries are shared with Dante, Onos and Riven Transmuters, so bank them and buy only whichever parts are still missing at the end.
Onos shares this same 5% Rotation B slot, so its blueprint can drop while you farm Ruvox.
bonuses: Steel Path Armatus pays 5-7 Capillaries per Demolisher instead of 2-4.
Killing a Gruzzling guarantees a Docket, so you don't have to wait on an Eximus drop to open a conduit.

disclosures.title: the B/C tradeoff
disclosures.body: From round 4 on, a clean round pays C (Dante) and never B. To keep drawing from B you have to let roughly 2 conduits fall each round, which costs you the Demolisher kills, and Capillaries, tied to those conduits. A short, clean run to round 3-4 often nets Ruvox parts and Capillaries better than deliberately bleeding conduits.
